response.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, f.shortintrt, f.optvolrt, AVG(f.shortintrt) OVER (PARTITION BY t.ordertypedist) AS mix_avg_short FROM sentimentandfundamentals f JOIN transactionrecord t ON f.transref = t.transreg) SELECT transreg AS transaction_ref, ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, AVG(shortintrt) AS avg_short_interest, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(shortintrt) / NULLIF(MAX(mix_avg_short), 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM s GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The order type mix is transactionrecord.ordertypedist. The benchmark average short interest for a mix is the average of shortintrt over all matched sentiment rows with that mix, ignoring NULLs. It is not an average of per-transaction averages.

Ratio = transaction's average short interest divided by the mix's average. It is NULL when either is missing or the mix average is 0. Transactions with no matching sentiment rows are excluded. A NULL mix value forms its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: The mix benchmark is the average of the per-transaction average short interest values, so each transaction counts equally regardless of how many sentiment rows it has.
alternatives.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT t.transreg, t.ordertypedist, AVG(f.shortintrt) AS a, AVG(f.optvolrt) AS o FROM sentimentandfundamentals f JOIN transactionrecord t ON f.transref = t.transreg GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), g AS (SELECT per.*, AVG(a) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS mix_avg FROM per) SELECT transreg AS transaction_ref, ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, a AS avg_short_interest, o AS avg_option_volume_ratio, a / NULLIF(mix_avg, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM g ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
